enabled.description: Indicates that this FITTED set needs plot-data.json.

family.description: ScatterPlot-compatible family used to generate the noisy observations.

expression.description: Exact hidden source expression. Stage 04 copies it into the correct FITTED model option.

min.description: Lower endpoint of the modeled scenario interval.

max.description: Upper endpoint of the modeled scenario interval.

domain.description: Closed interval on which observations are generated; min must be less than max.

rationale.description: Pipeline-only explanation of why the family supports the scenario and target calculus.

data.description: At least thirty realistically noisy observations sorted by nondecreasing x.

$comment: enabled must be false for CONSTRUCTED and true for FITTED. modelSpec.domain.min must be less than max and match the scenario interval. Every point x must lie in that domain; data must be sorted by nondecreasing x and represent noisy observations from modelSpec.expression. The assembler writes only plotData, never the wrapper or modelSpec, to the app plot-data.json.
